title: Broadcasting: Radio
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: BROADCASTING: PODCASTING AND RADIO Certificate of Achievement (CA) (Program Code 060410, State Code 21888)
outcomes: Students will write broadcast copy for audio and video, including news, sports, entertainment, promos, commercials, and public service announcements with emphasis on audio production.
Students will identify and apply theory and practice to create radio, podcasting, and television programs with emphasis on performance with emphasis on audio production.
Students will demonstrate producing, programming, and hosting skills within a studio, radio station, or television station structure with emphasis on audio production.

notes: The program is titled 'Broadcasting: Radio' in the state file; the catalog prints it as 'Broadcasting: Podcasting and Radio' Certificate of Achievement (State Code 21888). Its nine courses match the closed list exactly.
Catalog prints zero-padded codes (e.g., BRDCSTG 001); these were matched to the closed-list codes (BRDCSTG 1, etc.) and not marked as catalog additions.

Several catalog course titles differ from the state file titles (e.g., BRDCSTG 011 'Social Media Audio Production' vs. 'Digital Audio Editing and Production'; BRDCSTG 023 'Live Streaming Production' vs. 'News, Sports, and Live Remote Broadcasting'); reviewer may confirm.
Outcome 2 is copied as printed, including the repeated phrase 'with emphasis on performance with emphasis on audio production'.

The certificate shares its program student learning outcomes and description wording with the Podcasting and Radio AA degree on the previous page; the outcomes recorded are those printed under the certificate section itself.
Careers taken from the certificate description's 'develop skills for working in radio, TV, and voice-over'; these are career fields rather than explicit job titles.
